# Synthesis Summary — Quarter in Review Fixture

## Top Findings

Q1 2026 retrospective analysis of European Parliament activity across three legislative tracks: AI governance, trade defence, and financial regulation.

## Quarterly Retrospective

The 90-day period yielded above-average plenary throughput with 47 roll-call votes, 12 adopted texts, and 3 trilogues reaching political agreement. Coalition cohesion remained high (EPP-S&D-Renew bloc held on 83 % of contested votes).

## Throughput Delta

Dossier pipeline velocity increased 14 % quarter-on-quarter, driven by urgency procedures on trade and defence files. Committee productivity concentrated in ECON and INTA.
